description: Hand-written narration examples for BBCA and ANTM, each grounded only in field paths present in the other 1.1.0-draft.1 outputs for the same symbol/date. ANTM's narrative omits any breadth figure because that block is unavailable this run — a concrete demonstration of the LLM-cannot-state-what-it-was-not-given rule.

paragraphs: Over the 20 sessions ending 2026-09-09, the institutional cohort bought Rp 100,000,000 and sold Rp 140,000,000, a net of −Rp 40,000,000. The retail cohort ran the other way: Rp 80,000,000 bought against Rp 60,000,000 sold, a net of +Rp 20,000,000. The mixed cohort was flat at Rp 20,000,000 on both sides. The unknown cohort has no values for this window, so 92% of traded value is what these figures cover.

On the component view, sell value was concentrated — 61% sat with three brokers against a 38% baseline — while breadth stayed narrower, at 9 of 41 active brokers. Direction repeated in 6 of the last 10 sessions, with a longest run of 3.
This describes observed broker activity in BBCA. It is not a statement about price, and no cause is attributed to any outside event.

Over the 20 sessions ending 2026-09-09, the institutional cohort bought Rp 64,000,000 and sold Rp 91,000,000, a net of −Rp 27,000,000. The retail cohort bought Rp 52,000,000 against Rp 41,000,000 sold, a net of +Rp 11,000,000. The mixed cohort was flat at Rp 15,000,000 on both sides. The unknown cohort has no values for this window, so 88% of traded value is what these figures cover.

On the component view, sell value was concentrated — 55% sat with three brokers against a 33% baseline. Breadth could not be computed this run and is shown as unavailable, not as zero brokers changing side. Direction repeated in 5 of the last 10 sessions, with a longest run of 2.
This describes observed broker activity in ANTM. It is not a statement about price, and no cause is attributed to any outside event.
